_comment: Labels, groups and defaults for game rules. `rules`: the names since 1.21.11 (registry ids without `minecraft:`); `legacy`: the camelCase names before, either `as` a newer rule that means the same, or described in full where the meaning differs. Rules missing here still show, under Other. Defaults are checked against real new worlds (tests/fixtures).

rules.name: keep_inventory
rules.label: Keep inventory
rules.description: Players keep their items and experience when they die.

rules.name: immediate_respawn
rules.label: Respawn at once
rules.description: Players respawn without the death screen.

rules.name: natural_health_regeneration
rules.label: Health regenerates
rules.description: Players heal when their hunger bar is full enough.

rules.name: fall_damage
rules.label: Fall damage
rules.description: Players are hurt by falling.

rules.name: fire_damage
rules.label: Fire damage
rules.description: Players are hurt by fire and lava.

rules.name: drowning_damage
rules.label: Drowning damage
rules.description: Players are hurt when they run out of air.

rules.name: freeze_damage
rules.label: Freezing damage
rules.description: Players are hurt in powder snow.

rules.name: pvp
rules.label: Players can hurt each other
rules.description: Player-versus-player combat.

rules.name: players_sleeping_percentage
rules.label: Players needed to skip the night (%)
rules.description: How many of the players must sleep for the night to pass. Over 100 means it never passes by sleeping.

rules.name: respawn_radius
rules.label: Respawn radius
rules.description: How far from the world spawn point players appear, in blocks.

rules.name: ender_pearls_vanish_on_death
rules.label: Ender pearls vanish on death
rules.description: Thrown ender pearls disappear when their thrower dies.

rules.name: limited_crafting
rules.label: Only unlocked recipes
rules.description: Players can only craft recipes they have unlocked.

rules.name: locator_bar
rules.label: Locator bar
rules.description: Shows where other players are, on the experience bar.

rules.name: reduced_debug_info
rules.label: Reduced debug screen
rules.description: The debug screen (F3) leaves out coordinates and other details.

rules.name: player_movement_check
rules.label: Check player movement
rules.description: The server pulls back players who seem to move too fast.

rules.name: elytra_movement_check
rules.label: Check elytra movement
rules.description: The server pulls back players who seem to fly too fast with elytra.

rules.name: players_nether_portal_default_delay
rules.label: Nether portal delay (ticks)
rules.description: How long a player stands in a nether portal before it takes them, outside creative mode.

rules.name: players_nether_portal_creative_delay
rules.label: Nether portal delay in creative (ticks)
rules.description: The same, for players in creative mode.

rules.name: allow_entering_nether_using_portals
rules.label: Nether portals work
rules.description: Players can go to the Nether through portals.

rules.name: spectators_generate_chunks
rules.label: Spectators load new land
rules.description: Players in spectator mode cause new terrain to be generated.

rules.name: mob_griefing
rules.label: Mobs change the world
rules.description: Creepers break blocks, endermen pick them up, villagers farm, and so on.

rules.name: universal_anger
rules.label: Universal anger
rules.description: Angered neutral mobs attack every nearby player, not only the one who angered them.

rules.name: forgive_dead_players
rules.label: Mobs forgive the dead
rules.description: Angered neutral mobs calm down when the player they are angry at dies.

rules.name: max_entity_cramming
rules.label: Crowding limit
rules.description: How many mobs can share one space before they start taking damage. 0 turns it off.

rules.name: raids
rules.label: Raids
rules.description: Players with Bad Omen start raids in villages.

rules.name: spawn_mobs
rules.label: Mobs spawn
rules.description: Animals and monsters appear by themselves.

rules.name: spawn_monsters
rules.label: Monsters spawn
rules.description: Hostile mobs appear by themselves.

rules.name: spawn_patrols
rules.label: Pillager patrols
rules.description: Pillager patrols appear.

rules.name: spawn_phantoms
rules.label: Phantoms
rules.description: Phantoms come for players who haven't slept.

rules.name: spawn_wandering_traders
rules.label: Wandering traders
rules.description: Wandering traders come by.

rules.name: spawn_wardens
rules.label: Wardens
rules.description: Sculk shriekers can summon wardens.

rules.name: spawner_blocks_work
rules.label: Spawners work
rules.description: Monster spawner blocks spawn mobs.

rules.name: block_drops
rules.label: Blocks drop items
rules.description: Broken blocks drop themselves or their loot.

rules.name: entity_drops
rules.label: Entities drop items
rules.description: Minecarts, boats, item frames and the like drop as items when broken.

rules.name: mob_drops
rules.label: Mobs drop loot
rules.description: Killed mobs drop items and experience.

rules.name: block_explosion_drop_decay
rules.label: Block explosions lose drops
rules.description: Some blocks blown up by explosions caused by blocks drop nothing.

rules.name: mob_explosion_drop_decay
rules.label: Mob explosions lose drops
rules.description: Some blocks blown up by mobs' explosions drop nothing.

rules.name: tnt_explosion_drop_decay
rules.label: TNT explosions lose drops
rules.description: Some blocks blown up by TNT drop nothing.

rules.name: advance_time
rules.label: Day and night
rules.description: Time moves on and the sun moves across the sky.

rules.name: advance_weather
rules.label: Weather changes
rules.description: Rain and thunder come and go.

rules.name: random_tick_speed
rules.label: Random tick speed
rules.description: How fast crops grow, leaves decay and fire spreads. 0 stops it.

rules.name: fire_spread_radius_around_player
rules.label: Fire spreads within (blocks)
rules.description: How far from a player fire spreads and burns out, in blocks.

rules.name: spread_vines
rules.label: Vines spread
rules.description: Vines grow onto nearby blocks.

rules.name: water_source_conversion
rules.label: Water makes new sources
rules.description: Flowing water between two sources becomes a source.

rules.name: lava_source_conversion
rules.label: Lava makes new sources
rules.description: Flowing lava between two sources becomes a source.

rules.name: max_snow_accumulation_height
rules.label: Snow piles up to (layers)
rules.description: How many layers of snow build up while it snows.

rules.name: tnt_explodes
rules.label: TNT explodes
rules.description: Lit TNT explodes.

rules.name: projectiles_can_break_blocks
rules.label: Projectiles break blocks
rules.description: Projectiles can break blocks such as decorated pots and chorus flowers.

rules.name: global_sound_events
rules.label: Sounds heard everywhere
rules.description: Some sounds, such as a boss spawning, are heard by every player.

rules.name: max_minecart_speed
rules.label: Minecart top speed
rules.description: How fast minecarts can go, in blocks a second (an experimental feature).

rules.name: show_advancement_messages
rules.label: Announce advancements
rules.description: Chat says when a player completes an advancement.

rules.name: show_death_messages
rules.label: Death messages
rules.description: Chat says how players died.

rules.name: command_block_output
rules.label: Command block output
rules.description: Command blocks tell operators what they did.

rules.name: send_command_feedback
rules.label: Command feedback
rules.description: Players see the replies to their commands.

rules.name: log_admin_commands
rules.label: Tell operators about commands
rules.description: Operators and the server log see the commands operators run.

rules.name: command_blocks_work
rules.label: Command blocks work
rules.description: Command blocks run their commands.

rules.name: max_command_sequence_length
rules.label: Commands per function
rules.description: The most commands a function or command block chain may run in a tick.

rules.name: max_command_forks
rules.label: Command forks
rules.description: The most contexts one command may create (with execute).

rules.name: max_block_modifications
rules.label: Blocks one command may change
rules.description: The most blocks a single fill or clone may change.

legacy.name: disableRaids
legacy.label: No raids
legacy.description: Players with Bad Omen don't start raids.

legacy.name: disableElytraMovementCheck
legacy.label: Don't check elytra movement
legacy.description: The server doesn't pull back players who seem to fly too fast with elytra.

legacy.name: disablePlayerMovementCheck
legacy.label: Don't check player movement
legacy.description: The server doesn't pull back players who seem to move too fast.

legacy.name: allowFireTicksAwayFromPlayer
legacy.label: Fire spreads far from players
legacy.description: Fire also spreads where no player is near.

legacy.name: spawnChunkRadius
legacy.label: Spawn chunks (radius)
legacy.description: How many chunks around the world spawn stay loaded.
